name: Children & Parenting
overview: Scripture begins with God's command to be fruitful and multiply, establishing the divine purpose for children within the family (Genesis 1:28). The narratives of Adam and Eve's children, including Cain and Seth, highlight God's providential appointment of offspring as part of His covenantal plan (Genesis 4:1, 4:25). The account of Noah further underscores the importance of family preservation and obedience to God's covenant, as he and his sons were chosen to continue humanity (Genesis 6:18, 7:1). These passages collectively affirm the sacred role of parenting and the responsibility entrusted to families to nurture and uphold God's design for generations.
